brief.scenario: form found in the mailbox demanding the higher rent from the first of the month

catalog.role: Signed increase notice or form showing the form date and referenced rate or table
Publication excerpt for the referenced rate or calculation table and its effective period
Workflow or audit log showing when the final form content was prepared
Calculation worksheet showing the starting basis used for the notice
Authenticated administrative export for the notice, table reference and preparation history
Renovation cost breakdown supporting a value-added increase

must_convey: first-person account of the situation: form found in the mailbox demanding the higher rent from the first of the month
at least one concrete date and one concrete observation
must_not: state that any document is attached

must_convey: two statements about 'Authenticated administrative export for the notice, table reference and preparation history' conflict: the customer's own recollection versus what another party claims
the customer describes or quotes what the document 'Publication excerpt for the referenced rate or calculation table and its effective period' says (a date or an amount) from memory
the customer does NOT say they are sending it
what the customer wants checked now (the operational question)
an explicit statement of what remains unclear to them
before the current decision, establish: Signed form date, exact table with its period, and final preparation time

acceptable evidence: Signed increase notice or form showing the form date and referenced rate or table + Publication excerpt for the referenced rate or calculation table and its effective period + Workflow or audit log showing when the final form content was prepared OR Authenticated administrative export for the notice, table reference and preparation history
a party's description or recollection of a document does not establish its content; the document itself (or the authenticated export) is required
before the current decision, establish: Starting calculation basis linked to the notice
acceptable evidence: Calculation worksheet showing the starting basis used for the notice
a party's description or recollection of a document does not establish its content; the document itself (or the authenticated export) is required
conditional: Renovation cost breakdown (only once the notice reveals a renovation reason)

this obligation becomes active ONLY if a returned 'Signed increase notice or form showing the form date and referenced rate or table' reports the triggering circumstance; until then do not request 'Renovation cost breakdown supporting a value-added increase'
the following are not required for this check: Current rent-payment receipts
readiness means the listed facts are established from the required documents; it does not decide legal entitlement

the complete 'Signed increase notice or form showing the form date and referenced rate or table' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-SEQ'] with concrete values/dates; the document must NOT mention any circumstance related to 'Renovation cost breakdown (only once the notice reveals a renovation reason)'
the complete 'Publication excerpt for the referenced rate or calculation table and its effective period' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-SEQ'] with concrete values/dates
a cover note stating that the attached scan of 'Workflow or audit log showing when the final form content was prepared' is illegible / pages missing, so its content cannot be read
no substantive content
a legible complete 'Workflow or audit log showing when the final form content was prepared' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-SEQ']
the complete 'Calculation worksheet showing the starting basis used for the notice' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-BASIS'] with concrete values/dates
an incomplete 'Authenticated administrative export for the notice, table reference and preparation history': it gives part of the information but explicitly lacks a required element (state which)
it does not promise anything further
the complete 'Authenticated administrative export for the notice, table reference and preparation history' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-SEQ']
the complete 'Renovation cost breakdown supporting a value-added increase' establishing the fact(s) for ['R-RENOV'] with concrete values/dates
content of 'Current rent-payment receipts' that is genuinely unrelated to the facts under review

writer_rules: Write every paragraph as natural prose in the requested language (customer paragraphs in the customer's voice, instruction paragraphs as neutral handling guidance, return paragraphs as the document's own text or a cover note).
Vary sentence openings, register and length across paragraphs; never use meta-labels such as 'partial', 'final', 'hearsay' or the document IDs.
Never reveal whether a document will be sufficient; convey exactly the semantics in must_convey and nothing that contradicts must_not.
Return one JSON object mapping each paragraph id to its text.
